title: McpServerPreview
description: `POST /engines/:engine/mcp-servers/preview`: the description a save of this configuration would show and record — word for word (plan 13, B-18, S-68). `params` is a map of strings: the generator has no number type here, so a numeric field (such as a count) travels as its decimal text, the way `costUsd` already does elsewhere. Carrying `id` in the request body names the server being edited, and the response then lists which of the caller's own `allow` rules the save would revoke (plan 13, B-28, D-62, D-79).

params.description: Every value a string — a numeric field (a count) travels as its decimal text, the way `costUsd` already does elsewhere. Open: shaped by the server's transport.

revokedRules.description: The content of every `allow` rule of the caller that this edit would revoke, were it saved — the server's program (command, args, URL or transport) changed from what the rule was granted against (plan 13, B-26, D-12; B-28, D-62, D-79). Empty for a create, or an edit that keeps the program the same.
